item.title: Inside Iran's payments system
item.description: Fifty years of sanctions has forced the Middle Eastern country to develop its own isolated financial system. But money has still found a way to move in and out of the country.

item.title: Fincen is forcing banks to rethink some customer relationships
item.description: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network's expectations of banks that file suspicious activity reports have changed. Some banking clients may soon discover that they are less appealing customers than they used to be.

item.title: Iran prediction market trades spark insider trading concerns
item.description: The fresh scrutiny comes as financial firms like Goldman Sachs and Robinhood dabble with various prediction market options.

item.title: 'Software will get liberated': How to survive the SaaSpocalypse
item.description: Banks like Grasshopper are already starting to use AI agents where in the past they would have bought software as a service.

item.title: Kraken first crypto bank to get 'skinny' Fed master account
item.description: Traditional banks warn the Fed's decision to grant Kraken a limited-purpose master account introduces systemic risks before final rules are even in place.

item.title: Will Trump scramble Santander's plan to buy Webster?
item.description: Banco Santander's bid to buy U.S. regional bank Webster Financial could face surprise challenges following a dustup between President Trump and Spain's leaders over the war in Iran.

item.title: Ripple tweaks its tech for lurking stablecoin wave
item.description: The blockchain technology firm has added new processing tools for digital assets and traditional money, pitching itself as a destination for crypto-curious banks.

item.title: Brink's plans to buy NCR Atleos; Revolut chases premium accounts
item.description: By acquiring the ATM firm, Brink's hopes to expand in retail commerce. Plus, Revolut issues a card to compete with Amex; Standard Chartered has a new payments chief; and more in American Banker's global payments and fintech roundup.

item.title: House committee passes bank deregulatory package
item.description: The House Financial Services Committee passed a legislative package heavily favored by banks in a 26-16 vote

item.title: Newity on the hunt for new bank partners
item.description: The Chicago-based lender service provider, which has helped build Northeast Bank in Maine into an SBA powerhouse, has expanded its capacity with an AI-driven technology upgrade.
